review_round_3_addendum.r3_5_no_environment_source: PASS: no environment variable feeds the trusted store list. HSEOS_PNPM_STORE_DIRS, PNPM_STORE_DIR and npm_config_store_dir are ignored with a HSEOS_PNPM_ENV_IGNORED warning; the home directory comes from the account database, not from HOME. Accepted sources are controller files only: toolchain.pnpm_store_dirs in ~/.config/hseos/config.yaml or in the installation HSEOS configuration, ~/.config/pnpm/rc, and the pnpm default. Tests inject through the internal API trustPnpmStores. The exact attack runs through npm: a project .npmrc store-dir is exported by npm as npm_config_store_dir, the check runs from an npm script, and the result is PROJECT_STORE_DIR_NOT_ALLOWED
review_round_3_addendum.post_command_fingerprint: PASS: the fingerprint is recomputed after the verifier probe, after every acceptance command and after every model-invoked command. A mismatch discards the result (store-drift verdict, store_drift command status, tool error) and the command is recorded as not approved. Tests change the store during the probe, during an acceptance command, between the probe and the command guard (the command never launches) and during a model command
review_round_3_addendum.activation: the real vitest on this machine needs /workspace/.pnpm-store in toolchain.pnpm_store_dirs of the controller configuration; that activation is the owner decision, the measurement script trusts it through the internal API
review_round_3_addendum.mutants_killed: a source that reads the environment, a home taken from HOME, and removing each of the pre-launch, post-probe, post-command and tool post checks were applied and each failed the suite

review_round_3.r3_2_trust_boundary: a real v<N> directory created inside a trusted base is in the same trust boundary as the user store: whoever can create it already controls the store

review_round_2.r2_1_store_dir_not_forgeable: PASS: the pnpm store is trusted only through the controller (HSEOS_PNPM_STORE_DIRS, toolchain.pnpm_store_dirs in the HSEOS configuration, PNPM_STORE_DIR / npm_config_store_dir, ~/.config/pnpm/rc and the pnpm default). The project .modules.yaml only names the store for comparison; a storeDir outside the allowlist is refused with PROJECT_STORE_DIR_NOT_ALLOWED, and a project .npmrc is not a source. Applies to the protected verifier and to model-invoked commands
